# Toggle

> A 40×40 icon button that stays on or off, alone or as one choice in a group.

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | component |
| Contract | `review` · [toggle.contract.yaml](../../contracts/toggle.contract.yaml) |
| Guidance | `agreed` |
| Source | [Figma 168:1149](https://www.figma.com/design/1Zy0wiWKXQAvsfDBX3KR0d/UI-Kit-v01?node-id=168-1149) · read 2026-08-18 |
| Implemented in | The accounting app (`src/components/Toggle.tsx`, `.ak-toggle`) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected` | boolean |  | `false` |

## States

`Default` · `Hover` · `Pressed` · `Focus` · `Disabled`

## Anatomy

- `root`
- `icons-arrow-left`
- `union`
- `background`
- `focus-ring`

## When to use

- Switching a view or a filter on and off, when the change happens straight away.
- Picking one option from a short set, as a group. The year switcher in the accounting app works like this.

## When not to use

- Doing something. That's **IconButton**. A toggle remembers, a button doesn't.
- A settings-style switch with a label. There isn't one in the kit yet, so ask for one rather than stretching Toggle.

## Behaviour

It changes with `selected` and `state`. Off, it's a plate with 12px corners on the secondary surface, faded down. On, it becomes a fully round primary pill. The change of shape is part of the signal, not just the colour.

## Accessibility

- **Alone**: `<button aria-pressed="true|false">`.
- **Group**: `role="radio"` with `aria-checked`, inside a `role="radiogroup"` that has a name. Arrow keys move between options, Tab gets you in and out.
- **Name**: `aria-label` when it's icon only.
- **Focus**: `focus-ring` (2px, `actions/primary/focus/focus-ring` when it's on), on `:focus-visible`.
- **Colour**: on and off show in the shape (12px corners to fully round) as well as the colour.

## Content

Icon only in the kit. The accounting app adds a text label, and that's a declared deviation. If you add one, keep it to a short word or a number.

## Where code differs on purpose

| App | What | Why | Taken to design |
|---|---|---|---|
| The accounting app | Accepts a text label; width grows past 40px to fit it, height stays 40px. Label colour follows the surface: secondary label unselected, primary label selected. | The year switcher needs text. The kit's toggle is icon-only and specifies no label colour. | not yet |
| The accounting app | Rendered as role=radio inside a ToggleGroup radio group, which has no surface of its own. | Toggles are used as a single-choice set; ToggleGroup is not a kit component. | not yet |
